items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Jimmy Smith was his name, a bass player, out of the Missourians. He wanted me to come to the Savoy and go to work.

ctx.x: Now I got away from Stuff -- oh, yeah, now I've got to go back to when about '32, in the middle of that, things are happening in there, you know, with Stuff awhile and Lunceford awhile, and they sent for me to come down to -- Jimmy Smith was his name, a bass player, out of the Missourians. He wanted me to come to the Savoy and go to work.
Well, hold it one minute, now. Just one second. I keep stopping you at that same place. But tell me -- I mean you and Stuff became so very close.
